claims.claim: The Summons directs the defendant to file a written response with the court.
claims.quote: (3) A direction that the defendant file with the court a written pleading in response to the complaint within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.
claims.note: The required filing is a written pleading in response to the complaint.

claims.claim: The response period is 30 days after service of the Summons.
claims.quote: within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.
claims.note: Supported within the stated scope of summonses giving 30 days.

claims.claim: The filing deadline is 30 calendar days after service.
claims.quote: If the last day for the performance of any act provided or required by law to be performed within a specified period of time is a holiday, then that period is hereby extended to and including the next day that is not a holiday.
claims.note: The 30th calendar day is not always the filing deadline.

claims.claim: The count starts on the day after service.
claims.quote: The time in which any act provided by law is to be done is computed by excluding the first day, and including the last, unless the last day is a holiday, and then it is also excluded.

flags.text: The draft omits the last-day holiday extension under CCP-12a, whose definition of holiday includes Saturdays.
A reader could mistakenly believe the deadline has passed and forgo a still-timely response, risking default.

result.summary: The filing instruction, 30-day period, and start of the count are supported. The deadline statement omits an exception that can change the filing date.
